title: Watch the first outpost site: GSC-0044 and its six neighbours read every hour (who is there, pirates, fields)
note: Kept by Oracle; written 2026-11-17 11:25 UTC for orders.log ENT-036 (P4 a, block ORACLE: read GSC-0044 and its six neighbours again before the outpost is founded; scouts watch an outpost and warn). GSC-0044 is the site the Fleet Admiral chose (game/map/sites.tsv). Its lanes go to Acrux, Atlas, Botein, Cedarhold, HD 40307 and Intercrus; Intercrus, and Achernar on the road from The Experiment, stay on Military's census-guard-ice (every 60 minutes), so they are not listed here. Six systems, 3 to 7 jumps from home, all lawless: an empty hold (rule F13). A census reads and leaves; a pirate it meets is filed for Military (observe.py). Changed by Oracle 2026-11-17 15:28 UTC: the reads of 11:15 to 15:15 UTC came 70 to 75 minutes apart (every_minutes 60 is the floor of the gap, never its ceiling) and Intercrus, the sixth neighbour, was read once in four hours (census-frontier, census-guard-ice): Intercrus moves here from census-frontier, the threshold goes to 45 minutes and `chain` 3 reads the neighbours due within two lanes in the same trip; max_ships 3.
